main_text.p: vulgaris esto: Sanari potes, si decipi potes, si fidem habes amuleto. Principia rerum recenti succo esculenta, acrimonia sua palatum vellicant & salivam cient: decocto novitatis condimento, arescunt & insipida sunt media: quod deinceps ad finem vergit, nauseâ fœtet & vomitu: Vides brevi compendio, quam partem in rebus Vigor habeat, quam partem occupet Fastidium: Hanc devites, istam tene. Uni te mancipat, quæ in futurum prospicit anxiè, quæ momenta perpendit deliberatio: In arena consilium, quod de vitæ conditione statuat: Hanc cape vel illam: Non tantum interest, quantum suspicantur morosæ curæ: Qualis qualis ista sit, quam feligis, novitate placet, fastidium exclusit à vestibulo: Per principium ejus decurre, meta figatur ante medium:

page.notes: The page is a scan of a printed page with a slight skew. The text is clear; "succo" and "acrimonia" are read as printed with the hyphen-free forms. Show-through from the facing page is visible in the right margin and is omitted. The faint mark "vulgaris" at lower left is a show-through or catchword remnant and is not transcribed as text.
